summary: Full retest of NR Global Nexus rebrand. 25/25 backend pytest cases pass — including new expanded lead fields (designation/country/industry/monthly_budget), expanded careers application fields (current_location/qualification/current_salary/expected_salary/preferred_role), 8 careers openings (telecaller/web-dev/ayur-consult present, ai-engineer removed), 4 case studies w/ ayurveda-distribution, 5 testimonials w/ Sattva Ayurveda, and chatbot SSE + [LEAD_JSON] capture writing expanded fields. Frontend retested on Home, Services, Industries, About, Contact, Careers, Partnership — every spec'd data-testid present, partnership form persists a lead (form_type=partnership) via /api/leads, careers expanded form submits successfully.

issues: Footer tagline copy still reads 'Premium BPO, AI Solutions, Recruitment, Sales Outsourcing, Digital Marketing & Business Consulting...' — the rebrand removed 'AI Solutions' from the 8 services. This stale copy contradicts the new positioning (Outsourcing, Sales & Growth). Update the descriptive paragraph in Footer.jsx.

data-testid for IT & Technology card resolves to 'industry-card-it-&-technology' (or similar) instead of 'industry-card-it-technology'. The slugify likely keeps '&' or strips it unexpectedly. The card itself renders fine; only the testid slug differs from convention. Not blocking, but worth normalising the slug.

action_items: Update Footer.jsx description: drop 'AI Solutions' from the brand-line copy to match the rebrand (services list itself already updated).
Optional: Normalise the slug used for IT & Technology in Industries (testid 'industry-card-it-technology') for consistency with the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~540 lines combining endpoints + seeds + system prompt. Recommend extracting blog, leads, careers and chat into separate routers.
Chat endpoint still replays prior turns by calling chat.send_message synchronously before streaming — doubles latency/cost. Pass history as system context instead.

Logger is module-initialised AFTER it's referenced inside chat_endpoint — works because the coroutine runs later, but fragile. Move logging.basicConfig() and logger = logging.getLogger(...) near the top.
Storing resume_b64 in MongoDB scales poorly — move to object storage (S3/GCS) when volume grows.
CORS allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' is unsafe in production; restrict origins via env.

The Partnership form submits to /api/leads with form_type='partnership' and service=<partner_type>; verified end-to-end. Careers form is multipart and posts to /api/careers/apply with the 5 new fields.
rca of the issue: No new functional issues to RCA. Only a content-copy mismatch in Footer.jsx where the brand descriptor still mentions 'AI Solutions', which is out of scope for the rebrand. Reproduction: visit any page footer; the small paragraph under the logo reads 'Premium BPO, AI Solutions, Recruitment, ...'. Mitigation: edit Footer.jsx descriptor to e.g., 'Premium BPO, Project Outsourcing, Recruitment, Lead Generation, Digital Marketing & Business Consulting — engineered to scale ambitious businesses globally.'
